configuration_profile: real nginx HPACK block decoder and HTTP/2 request-header processor attached to a synthetic live stream, with a minimal fuzz.test virtual-server hash
allocator_mode: fresh nginx connection and request pools per input
justification: IF15 decodes HPACK without a request stream and IF16 exercises decoded fields directly. This target joins real HPACK decoding to the actual request-header processing path and includes authority host selection.
state: Each input is decoded by ngx_http_v2_state_header_block with one live synthetic request. Decoded fields run through ngx_http_v2_state_process_header. The one-entry virtual-name hash selects fuzz.test; request execution is stopped at header completion.
known_limitations: The adapter starts after HEADERS framing; frame envelopes and CONTINUATION sequencing are covered separately by IF11/IF15.
Malformed header errors are captured before request finalization and posted-event processing.
Path values capable of triggering URI error-finalization are skipped.
The request stops before ngx_http_v2_run_request, routing, body handling, and application phases.

scopes.contract: Decode a bounded HPACK block, validate/process its fields against one request, detect duplicate/invalid pseudo-headers, and perform authority host selection without entering request execution.
scopes.preconditions: Fresh pools, initialized nginx modules, one synthetic stream, a valid minimal core/v2 configuration, and an exact fuzz.test virtual-name hash entry.
